messages:
Sam H: Hey team — need to swap my Sunday night oncall (9pm-1am PST). Unexpected travel. Can someone cover 2027-01-10 21:00-01:00 PST? I can trade Wed 21:00-01:00 if that helps.

Joel P: I can take the slot if nobody else steps up. @Sam H please drop handoff notes and any hotspots.

Sam H: Thanks @Joel P — added notes below.
Handoff overview:
- Primary cluster: us-west-2-g1 (GPU pool A)
- Expected traffic: low (weekend), but we have a scheduled model bake at 22:00 UTC that could increase requests briefly.
- Known risk: autoscaler v2 sometimes fails to bring up burst nodes after quantized model load — watch PodPending >3m.

Quick checks to run on takeover:
```
# verify serving nodes healthy
kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -l serving-role=worker
r10k check cluster us-west-2-g1

# check model pin & fallback
curl -sS https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/models/current | jq .model
```

Playbook links: https://wiki.redwood/internal/oncall/handoffs

Short list of recent alerts: (none last 4h) — monitor token-queue latency.

Joel P: Got it. I'll pick up. Also can you confirm the bake rollout details? Is it canary or full?

Mia L: FYI — bake at 22:00 UTC is a controlled canary (5% traffic -> 50% -> full) with automated rollback at regression. If a regression triggers, dedicated fallback is set to model-legacy-3b.

Ravi K: @Joel P if you see autoscaler errors, ping me and I can force a node replace. Also check console > Rollouts for the canary state.

Oncall Bot: Reminder — Scheduled bake rollout for model-optimizer at 2027-01-10T22:00:00Z. Watch /alerts. Link: https://alerts.redwood/internal/rollouts/1234

Joel P: Thanks all — I'll leave a short log here after I take over. :thumbsup:

Sam H: Appreciate it, Joel. I'll DM you the calendar invite and my mobile in case of travel issues.

Joel P: Received. Handoff complete — taking 2027-01-10 21:00-01:00 PST. Monitoring console and alerts. If anything spikes, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping @Ravi K.

Oncall Bot: User Joel P acked takeover at 2027-01-10T20:47:01Z
